description: Against a real SQLite: a client `!` whose one server call is a non-`!` function running two INSERTs. move(6) fails after them inside the composed batch — both rows rolled back; move(1) commits two rows. Count 2 (4 without the envelope), @r = 1.
spec: §8.9.2 · §19.9.9.8 rule 1 · §19.10.5 · S474 ruling (capability over limitation, item 2)
rationale: S474 (user-voice-scrml.md, capability over limitation, item 2): "a client `!` whose one server call is a non-`!` server function running two queries … the compiler wraps that server call in the transaction envelope when the caller is `!`." Was the S473 D1 refusal (E-BOOTSTRAP-UNSUPPORTED).
